instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Step 2 of an admin rotation, signed by the proposed key.

accounts.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed successor - must sign; validated against `config.pending_admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config PDA - `admin` and `pending_admin` are rewritten here.

instructions.name: borrow
docs: Draw cash against locked collateral, capped at `F × collateral`.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Borrower - must own the position (has_one). Pays rent if `owner_cash`
is created.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market lending the cash - holds the reserves, debt totals, and the
floor price `F`; signs the vault payouts as vault authority.
PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

accounts.name: position
docs: Borrower's lending position - collateral backs the draw, debt is increased.
PDA derived from ["position", market, owner]; has_one pins the owner.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market cash vault - source of the borrowed cash and all fee legs.
Validated to match `market.vault`.

accounts.name: creator_claim
docs: Creator fee escrow - receives the creator leg of the origination fee.
Validated to match `market.creator_claim`.

accounts.name: team_vault
docs: **Pinned by seeds**, not left bare. This account receives the team fee leg, and
on the vault-funded paths that leg is paid out by the market PDA — so an
unconstrained account here would let any caller redirect the team fee to
themselves. Re-derived from `[TEAM_VAULT_SEED, mint_main]`, the same account
`withdraw_team_fees` sweeps, which is what makes the destination structural.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - validated to match `market.mint_main`.

accounts.name: owner_cash
docs: Receives the borrowed cash — created on the fly if the borrower has never
held the collateral (init_if_needed, rent paid by the borrower).

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program for base currency transfers.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: Associated token program - needed to create `owner_cash` on the fly.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy with an exact cash amount. Quotes by bisection on the exact forward
cost, splits obligation-first, and asserts Law 1 before moving anything.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: The buyer - signs, pays `cash_in` from `buyer_cash`, and pays rent for
`buyer_token` on a wallet's first buy.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market being bought into - PDA derived from `[MARKET_SEED, mint_token]`,
signs the mint CPI and holds the reserves ledger updated by this trade.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Pinned by an `address` check against the key `Market` stored at creation, so a
substituted account is rejected.

accounts.name: creator_claim
docs: Creator claim account - receives the creator's leg of the buy fee.
Pinned by an `address` check against the key `Market` stored at creation.

accounts.name: team_vault
docs: **Global per collateral** — shared by every market on this mint. Taking it
writable is v1 parity by founder decision, and it is why buys on markets
sharing a collateral serialise: Solana orders transactions that write the
same account. The ledger-accrual alternative is recorded in the design.
**Pinned by seeds**, not left bare. This account receives the team fee leg, and
on the vault-funded paths that leg is paid out by the market PDA — so an
unconstrained account here would let any caller redirect the team fee to
themselves. Re-derived from `[TEAM_VAULT_SEED, mint_main]`, the same account
`withdraw_team_fees` sweeps, which is what makes the destination structural.

accounts.name: reflection_vault
docs: on reflection markets; on a `reflection_bps == 0` market (incl. every
pre-upgrade market) it may not exist and is never touched. The seeds check
pins the address without requiring init; `transfer_checked` validates it as
a `mint_main` token account when the reflection leg actually fires.

accounts.name: mint_token
docs: Market token mint - `token_out` is minted from it to the buyer.
Validated to match `market.mint_token`, so a foreign mint is rejected.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - buyer pays in this token.
Validated to match `market.mint_main`; needed for `transfer_checked` decimals.

accounts.name: buyer_cash
docs: Buyer's base-currency account - source of `cash_in`, debited by the three
transfer legs. Must already exist: whoever holds the funds holds the account.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The buyer's canonical ATA for the market token, created on the fly on a
wallet's first buy (`init_if_needed` — a no-op when it exists, rent paid
by the buyer). Receiving accounts are init_if_needed; paying accounts
(`buyer_cash`) must exist — whoever holds the funds holds the account.
The `associated_token` constraints also pin the canonical ATA, which the
old bare `token::mint` check did not.

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program for base-currency transfers (vault, creator and team legs).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the market token - used by the mint CPI and `buyer_token`.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: Associated token program - required by `init_if_needed` on `buyer_token`.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation (`buyer_token` rent on a first buy).

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees
docs: Sweep a market's accrued creator fees. Signed by whoever is **currently**
`market.creator`, so a CTO hands the market over with its unclaimed earnings.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Whoever is **currently** `market.creator`. That is the whole CTO story in one
constraint: a reassignment hands the market over with its unclaimed earnings,
because the right to claim follows the field rather than the person who earned
them. Two residuals were accepted with that decision — the admin can reassign
then claim, and the chain keeps no attribution of who earned what.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market whose fees are being claimed - source of truth for `creator` and
vault authority. PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

accounts.name: creator_claim
docs: Creator-fee vault - accumulates the creator's fee share for this market;
the market PDA is its transfer authority. Derived from ["creator_claim", market].

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - validated to match `market.mint_main`,
so the vault, destination, and `transfer_checked` all agree on the mint.

accounts.name: destination
docs: The creator's canonical collateral ATA — created on the fly on the first
claim (init_if_needed, rent paid by the creator). The associated_token
constraints also pin the destination to the creator, which the old bare
token::mint check did not.

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program for base currency transfers.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: Associated token program - required to create `destination` on first claim.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation (destination ATA rent).

instructions.name: close_reflection_epoch
docs: Close a finished reflection epoch, returning its rent to the admin.

accounts.name: reflection_epoch
docs: Closed here; its rent lamports return to `admin`.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Lock market tokens as collateral.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Depositor - signs the token transfer and pays rent if the position is created.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market being deposited into - its `total_collateral` is increased.
PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

accounts.name: position
docs: Per-user lending position - tracks this owner's collateral and debt.
Created on first deposit (init_if_needed, rent paid by owner).
PDA derived from ["position", market, owner].

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: Market collateral vault - receives the deposited tokens.
PDA derived from ["collateral_vault", market].

accounts.name: mint_token
docs: Market token mint - validated to match `market.mint_token`.

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: Owner's market-token account - source of the deposit.
Constraints pin it to `mint_token`.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for market-token transfers.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for position account creation.

instructions.name: distribute_reflection
docs: Pay a batch of holders from the reflection vault. Bitmap-idempotent and
bounded by the frozen epoch pool. Holder ATAs ride in `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Create the protocol singleton. Callable once. The signer becomes the admin.

accounts.name: initializer
docs: Gated on a compile-time key rather than on `config.admin`, because there is
no admin yet — this instruction is what creates one.
**The signer becomes the admin.** There is no `admin` argument: on a real
cluster the initializer and the admin are the same Squads multisig, so
passing it would add an argument whose only effect is a chance to mistype.

accounts.name: config
docs: Singleton-ness is structural: `init` on a fixed-seed PDA fails on the
second call because the account already exists. No flag to check.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for creating the config account.

instructions.name: init_market
docs: Permissionless market creation. Mint + vaults + curve params + snapshot.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Market creator - pays rent for every account created here and is recorded
as `market.creator` (the initial claimant of creator fees).

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config PDA - read for `current_fee_config_version` to pin the
fee config below. Seeds guarantee it is the program's singleton.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Pinned at creation and frozen for the market's life. Must be the currently
published version — a caller cannot reach back for cheaper old rates.

accounts.name: collateral_config
docs: The allowlist gate. Its mere existence is the permission: no
`CollateralConfig`, no market — and this account is read here, once, then
never again on any trade.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - the market's cash side. Validated to be
owned by `token_program_main`; further screened in the handler for unsafe
Token-2022 extensions.

accounts.name: mint_token
docs: Token-2022 metadata extension, and we deliberately allocate the *maximum* so
a CTO metadata rewrite never needs a realloc.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market state being created - the immutable snapshot of curve, fee and
glide parameters. PDA derived from ["market", mint_token], so one market
exists per mint.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The single cash vault. `floor_reserve` and `price_reserve` are ledgers on
`Market` pointing into this one account, never separate vaults.

accounts.name: creator_claim
docs: Claimable only by whoever is *currently* `market.creator`, so a CTO hands
the market over with its unclaimed earnings.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: not exist yet when Anchor evaluates constraints.

accounts.name: reflection_vault
docs: Reflection-reward vault (collateral). Created for every market — holds the
reflection tax until distribution; stays empty on a `reflection_bps == 0`
market. `mint_main`-denominated, so it can use Anchor `init` like `vault`.

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program owning `mint_main` (Token or Token-2022) - used for the cash
vault and creator claim accounts.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Always Token-2022: the market mint carries the metadata extension.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation.

instructions.name: leverage_buy
docs: Borrow, buy, and lock the result as collateral, atomically. The borrowed cash
never leaves the vault — the borrow's payout and the buy's payment cancel — so
this costs the same three transfers as a plain buy.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Buyer - signs, funds `cash_in`, and pays rent for the position on first use.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market being levered into - holds every ledger and signs the vault-funded
legs and the mint. PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

accounts.name: position
docs: Buyer's loan position - tracks collateral and debt. PDA derived from
["position", market, buyer]; created on the first leveraged buy
(`init_if_needed`, rent paid by the buyer).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Main cash vault - receives `cash_in` and pays the fee legs. Pinned by an
`address` check against the key `Market` stored at creation, so a substituted
account is rejected.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: The bought tokens are minted straight here. They are never in the buyer's
hands, which is what makes the loan's collateral unconditional rather than
dependent on a second signature.

accounts.name: creator_claim
docs: Creator claim account - receives the creator fee legs. Pinned by an `address`
check against the key stored at creation.

accounts.name: team_vault
docs: **Pinned by seeds**, not left bare. This account receives the team fee leg, and
on the vault-funded paths that leg is paid out by the market PDA — so an
unconstrained account here would let any caller redirect the team fee to
themselves. Re-derived from `[TEAM_VAULT_SEED, mint_main]`, the same account
`withdraw_team_fees` sweeps, which is what makes the destination structural.

accounts.name: reflection_vault
docs: on reflection markets; on a `reflection_bps == 0` market (incl. every
pre-upgrade market) it may not exist and is never touched. `transfer_checked`
validates it when the reflection leg fires.

accounts.name: mint_token
docs: Market token mint - the bought tokens are minted from it into the collateral
vault. Validated to match `market.mint_token`.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - the buyer pays in this token. Validated to
match `market.mint_main`.

accounts.name: buyer_cash
docs: Buyer's cash account - pays `cash_in`. Paying accounts must already exist
(never `init_if_needed`); constrained to the `mint_main` mint.

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program for base currency transfers.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the market token - used for the mint into the collateral vault.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for position account creation.

instructions.name: leverage_sell
docs: Sell collateral without releasing it, repay the debt from the proceeds, and pay
out the remainder. Closes a position whose debt exceeds the holder's free cash.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Position owner - signs, receives the residual payout, and pays rent for
`owner_cash` if it does not exist yet.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market being unwound - holds every ledger and signs the burn and the
vault payouts. PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

accounts.name: position
docs: Owner's loan position - tracks collateral and debt. PDA derived from
["position", market, owner]; `has_one` pins it to the signer, so nobody can
unwind someone else's position.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Main cash vault - every payout leaves from here. Pinned by an `address` check
against the key `Market` stored at creation, so a substituted account is rejected.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: Collateral vault PDA - holds the locked tokens; `collateral_in` is burned
straight out of it, never released to the owner. Derived from
["collateral_vault", market].

accounts.name: creator_claim
docs: Creator claim account - receives the creator fee leg. Pinned by an `address`
check against the key stored at creation.

accounts.name: team_vault
docs: **Pinned by seeds**, not left bare. This account receives the team fee leg, and
on the vault-funded paths that leg is paid out by the market PDA — so an
unconstrained account here would let any caller redirect the team fee to
themselves. Re-derived from `[TEAM_VAULT_SEED, mint_main]`, the same account
`withdraw_team_fees` sweeps, which is what makes the destination structural.

accounts.name: reflection_vault
docs: on reflection markets; on a `reflection_bps == 0` market (incl. every
pre-upgrade market) it may not exist and is never touched. `transfer_checked`
validates it when the reflection leg fires.

accounts.name: mint_token
docs: Market token mint - the burn target. Validated to match `market.mint_token`.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - all payouts are in this token. Validated to
match `market.mint_main`.

accounts.name: owner_cash
docs: Receives the residual payout — created on the fly if the owner has never
held the collateral (init_if_needed, rent paid by the owner).

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program for base currency transfers.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the market token - used for the collateral burn.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: Associated token program - creates `owner_cash` on first use.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation.

instructions.name: open_reflection_epoch
docs: Open a reflection distribution epoch: skim the gas reserve to the treasury,
freeze the (net) pool, and size the paid bitmap to the snapshot's holders.

accounts.name: reflection_vault
docs: The reflection pool. Skim source; frozen (net) into the epoch below.

accounts.name: admin_destination
docs: The admin's own ATA for `mint_main`: receives the `gas_reserve` skim so the
admin (who pays the distribution gas out of its own SOL) is reimbursed.
Created on the fly if missing (rent paid by `admin`). The associated_token
constraints pin the destination to the admin — it cannot be redirected.

accounts.name: unwrap_holding
docs: Transient collateral holding account, created and closed within this
instruction. For a native (WSOL) market it receives the frozen pool and is
closed into `reflection_epoch`, converting the pool to native lamports the
distribute step pays directly. For any other collateral it stays empty and
is closed straight back to `admin`.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Step 1 of an admin rotation. The successor must accept before it takes effect.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Current admin - must sign; validated against `config.admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config PDA - `pending_admin` is written here.

instructions.name: publish_fee_config
docs: Append an immutable fee version. Reaches new markets only — no live market
is touched, and no instruction exists that could change one.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Protocol admin - must sign; validated against `config.admin`.
Mutable because it pays rent for the new fee config account.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config PDA - `current_fee_config_version` is advanced here.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: `version` is an argument because PDA seeds must be known before the handler
runs; the handler then asserts it is exactly `current + 1`. `init` makes the
append-only property structural — an existing version cannot be rewritten.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for creating the fee config account.

instructions.name: raise_floor_excess_liquidity
docs: Cash-funded raise, permissionless. The **only** path that lowers the derived
ramp end, so the only one that can leave a ramp-band state.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless: the verifier is the defence, not the signer. Anyone may pay
to push a market's floor up to what its own committed cash already supports.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market whose floor is being raised. PDA derived from
["market", mint_token] — the seeds constraint pins it to its own token mint.

instructions.name: raise_floor_preserve_area
docs: Area-preserving raise: converts price-discovery area into guaranteed value.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless: the verifier is the defence, not the signer. Anyone may pay
to submit an off-chain-solved raise; every constraint is re-asserted on-chain.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market whose floor is being raised. PDA derived from
["market", mint_token] — the seeds constraint pins it to its own token mint.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Repay principal. **Ungateable** — reads no flag and no pause.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The position owner, and only them. The design doc (ix 17) proposed a
permissionless repay for v1 parity; the founder overrode that — a position may
be de-risked only by the account that opened it. `has_one` + the PDA seed pin
it both ways.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market owed the debt - its reserves and `total_debt` are updated.
PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

accounts.name: position
docs: Owner's lending position - its debt is reduced.
PDA derived from ["position", market, owner]; has_one pins the owner.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market cash vault - receives the repaid cash.
Validated to match `market.vault`.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - validated to match `market.mint_main`.

accounts.name: owner_cash
docs: Owner's base-currency account - source of the repayment.
Constraints pin it to `mint_main`.

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program for base currency transfers.

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell tokens back into the curve. Pays the floor-attributable share from the
floor earmark and the rest from the above-floor book; reverts if that book
cannot cover it.

accounts.name: seller
docs: Seller - signs the burn of their tokens and receives the payout.
Mutable because it pays rent if `seller_cash` has to be created.

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market being sold into - PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].
Vault authority: signs every payout leg out of the vault.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market vault holding both cash ledgers (floor reserve + above-floor book).
Validated to match `market.vault` - source of every payout leg.

accounts.name: creator_claim
docs: Creator claim account - receives the creator's fee leg, swept later via
`claim_creator_fees`. Validated to match `market.creator_claim`.

accounts.name: team_vault
docs: **Pinned by seeds**, not left bare. This account receives the team fee leg, and
on the vault-funded paths that leg is paid out by the market PDA — so an
unconstrained account here would let any caller redirect the team fee to
themselves. Re-derived from `[TEAM_VAULT_SEED, mint_main]`, the same account
`withdraw_team_fees` sweeps, which is what makes the destination structural.

accounts.name: reflection_vault
docs: on reflection markets; on a `reflection_bps == 0` market (incl. every
pre-upgrade market) it may not exist and is never touched. `transfer_checked`
validates it when the reflection leg fires.

accounts.name: mint_token
docs: Market token mint - the sold tokens are burned against it, shrinking supply.
Validated to match `market.mint_token`.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - seller is paid in this token.
Validated to match `market.mint_main`.

accounts.name: seller_cash
docs: Receives the payout — created on the fly if the seller has never held the
collateral (init_if_needed, rent paid by the seller).

accounts.name: seller_token
docs: The burn source, pinned to the seller's canonical ATA — same discipline as
`buy`'s `buyer_token`. **Not** `init_if_needed`: unlike a receiving account,
the burn source must already exist and hold the tokens. A bare `token::mint`
check would have let any market-token account the seller can burn from stand
in; pinning the ATA makes the source canonical.

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program for base currency transfers (vault payouts).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the market token (the burn).

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: Associated token program - creates `seller_cash` if it does not exist yet.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation.

instructions.name: set_collateral_config
docs: List or retune a collateral, and create its per-collateral team vault.
No `CollateralConfig` means no market can be created on that mint.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Protocol admin - must sign; validated against `config.admin`.
Mutable because it pays rent for the collateral config and team vault on first listing.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config PDA - validates the admin, and is the team vault's token authority.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Loaded through `token_interface` so either token program is accepted; the
screen in the handler decides whether this particular mint is allowed.

accounts.name: collateral_config
docs: Per-collateral config PDA - derived from ["collateral", mint_main].
`init_if_needed` lets the same instruction both list and retune.

accounts.name: team_vault
docs: **Global per collateral** — one vault shared by every market on this mint,
authority = the config PDA so only the program can move it.
Note this is the account the founder decision makes writable on `buy`, which
serialises buys across every market sharing the collateral.

accounts.name: token_program_main
docs: Token program owning `mint_main` - SPL Token or Token-2022, hence the interface.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation.

instructions.name: set_market_flags
docs: Per-market circuit breaker. Cannot reach withdraw or repay — those have no
flag bit at all.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Global admin - the only signer allowed to flip market flags; validated
against `config.admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config PDA - source of truth for the admin key. Seeds: ["config"].

accounts.name: market
docs: Market whose flags are being set - only `flags` and `state_seq` are
written. PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

instructions.name: update_market
docs: CTO path: token metadata and/or the market's creator wallet. Admin-held.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Global admin - the only signer allowed to run a CTO; validated against
`config.admin`. No creator co-signature is required (see header).

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config PDA - source of truth for the admin key. Seeds: ["config"].

accounts.name: market
docs: Market being updated - holds the creator, fee split, and floor/reflexive
parameters, and signs the metadata CPI as the mint's update authority.
PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

accounts.name: mint_token
docs: metadata inline; the Market PDA is its update authority.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the metadata CPIs - the mint stores its metadata inline
via the Token-2022 metadata extension.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Release collateral. **Ungateable** — reads no flag and no pause.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Position owner - must match `position.owner` (has_one).

accounts.name: market
docs: Rise market - holds the floor price `F` for the release bound and signs
the vault transfer as `collateral_vault` authority.
PDA derived from ["market", mint_token].

accounts.name: position
docs: Owner's lending position - its collateral is reduced.
PDA derived from ["position", market, owner]; has_one pins the owner.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: Market collateral vault - source of the released tokens.
PDA derived from ["collateral_vault", market].

accounts.name: mint_token
docs: Market token mint - validated to match `market.mint_token`.

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: Owner's market-token account - receives the released collateral.
Constraints pin it to `mint_token`.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for market-token transfers.

instructions.name: withdraw_team_fees
docs: Sweep a collateral's team vault. Permissionless trigger, single pinned
destination: a stranger can cause the sweep but can never redirect it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: **Permissionless trigger.** Anyone may pay to move team fees, because the
destination is pinned by a constraint and not by the caller: a stranger can
cause the sweep but can never redirect it. That also means the team never has
to hold SOL to collect.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config PDA - holds the immutable `team_wallet` and, being the
vault's authority, signs the transfer. Seeds: ["config"].

accounts.name: team_vault
docs: Global per collateral, shared by every market on this mint.

accounts.name: mint_main
docs: Base currency mint (e.g., USDC) - selects which per-collateral vault is
swept via the `team_vault` seeds; also supplies `transfer_checked` decimals.

accounts.name: team_wallet
docs: Pinned to `config.team_wallet` by an account constraint, so the sweep has
exactly one possible destination. `team_wallet` is itself immutable — there is
no `update_team_wallet` — which is what makes "not even the admin can redirect
the fee destination" structural rather than checked.
the ATA-create CPI needs the authority as an account, never read or written.

accounts.name: team_destination
docs: Team wallet's canonical ATA for `mint_main` - created on the fly on the
first withdrawal (init_if_needed, rent paid by `payer`). The
associated_token constraints pin it to `team_wallet`, closing the redirect path.

accounts.name: token_program_main

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: Associated token program - required to create `team_destination` if missing.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation (destination ATA rent).

fields.name: drawn_from_floor
docs: How much of the draw came out of the floor earmark — the Mayflower rule in
one number, matched one-for-one by the receivable.

fields.name: floor_reserve
docs: Market-wide post-state, for the indexer's aggregate columns.

fields.name: obligation
docs: `ceil(F × token_out)` — the Law-1 leg, credited before anything else.

fields.name: cum_net_inflow
docs: Post-trade glide progress — the indexer's quote state, so it never reads
the Market account back.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump, stored so every instruction re-derives instead of trusting input.

fields.name: mint_main
docs: The collateral mint this config is keyed on. Stored so every consumer can
assert the passed mint matches, rather than trusting the caller's pairing.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Cached from the mint account — **read from the mint, never an argument.**
An admin typo of 6 for a 9-decimal mint would silently corrupt every price
and amount downstream with no error anywhere. Safe to cache because SPL
mint decimals are immutable.

fields.name: min_trade_amount
docs: Anti-dust minimum in raw units, supplied explicitly. This is the
rounding-harvest defence, so there is no fallback formula to get it subtly
wrong — see `MIN_TRADE_AMOUNT_FLOOR`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Padding so a future field needs no migration.

fields.name: updated
docs: False on the first listing, true when an existing listing is retuned —
the two are the same instruction, so the event has to disambiguate.

fields.name: creator
docs: Whoever held `market.creator` at claim time — not necessarily whoever earned it.

fields.name: total_collateral
docs: Market-wide post-state, for the indexer's aggregate columns.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump, stored so every instruction re-derives instead of trusting input.

fields.name: version
docs: Strictly sequential from 1. Seeds are `[FEE_CONFIG_SEED, version_le]`, so
each version lives at its own address and none can be rewritten.

fields.name: borrow_fee_mbps
docs: Origination fee on the borrowed amount. Launch: `30_000` = 3%.

fields.name: redeem_fee_mbps
docs: Reserved: `redeem_at_floor` was removed. Kept so a future re-add needs no
`FeeConfig` migration.

fields.name: team_share_bps
docs: The protocol's share of every fee, in bps of the fee taken. Launch `7_500`.
This is the **only** split value that is protocol policy. The remaining
`10_000 − team_share_bps` is split per market between the creator and the
floor, chosen at `init_market` — see `Market::fees_*`. Kept here rather
than passed at creation because `init_market` is permissionless: an
argument would let a creator submit `0` and keep the protocol's share.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Padding so a future field needs no migration.

fields.name: preserve_area
docs: Which path ran: the area-preserving accelerator, or the cash-funded raise
that is the only one able to leave a ramp-band state.

fields.name: m_x1
docs: `m_x1_cached` after the raise's `refresh_memos()` — the third geometry memo,
so the indexer mirrors curve state without re-deriving it.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump, stored so every instruction re-derives instead of trusting input.

fields.name: admin
docs: Protocol admin: publishes fee configs, lists collaterals, sets market
flags, and holds the CTO path. Required to be a Squads multisig.
Explicitly **cannot**: lower a floor, touch any vault, mint tokens, change
a live market's curve, change a live market's fees, or redirect the team
fee destination. Those powers are absent from the program, not gated.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step rotation target; `Pubkey::default()` when nothing is pending.
A single-step rotation to a mistyped key would brick every admin path,
so the successor must sign to accept.

fields.name: team_wallet
docs: Destination of team fee sweeps. **Immutable for the life of the program** —
`update_team_wallet` does not exist in v2, which makes non-redirectability
structural rather than checked.
The flip side, and why this must be a multisig: a lost *or compromised*
key is permanent and unfixable, since no redeploy can alter an existing
PDA. Rotation lives at the Squads member layer instead.

fields.name: current_fee_config_version
docs: Latest published `FeeConfig`. New markets pin this version at creation and
keep it for life. `0` means none published yet, so no market can be
created — see `publish_fee_config`.

fields.name: curve_kind
docs: Selects what `char_params` means. Only `Linear` is evaluable today; the
hinged-exponential family plugs in behind the same discriminant.

fields.name: hinge_x
docs: Supply (raw units) where the hinged exponential ignites; must be 0 for
the linear family.

fields.name: char_params
docs: Linear: `(p0, m, _, _)` — `M(x) = p0 + m·x`, both Q64.64. **No curve table**:
the shape is these numbers, evaluated directly, so nothing has to travel in
the transaction and the point-count question disappears entirely.

fields.name: ramp_scalar
docs: Q64.64, pinned per preset. `> 1`. Never a runtime lever.

fields.name: fees_creator
docs: The **only** caller input to the fee split: `0..=(10_000 − fees_team)` bps
of the fee — no standalone cap, the remainder computation is the bound.
`fees_team` comes from the pinned FeeConfig and `fees_floor` is the computed
remainder (zero allowed), so no argument combination can break `Σ = 10_000`.

fields.name: q_max_bps
docs: Declared stress depth, in bps of supply.

fields.name: self_healing
docs: Opt into the self-healing sell semantics (`SELF_HEALING.md`) at birth.
Immutable for the market's life — the bit is outside `WRITABLE_MASK`.

fields.name: reflection_bps
docs: Reflection tax pinned at birth, bps of the trade: must be one of
`REFLECTION_BPS_ALLOWED` (0 / 100 / 300). Immutable for life. Appended
last so old serialized args stay prefix-compatible.

fields.name: floor_reserve
docs: Market-wide post-state, for the indexer's aggregate columns.

fields.name: floor_reserve
docs: Market-wide post-state + post-contraction geometry memos (unchanged values
when `contracted` is false), for the indexer's aggregate columns.

fields.name: book_shortfall
docs: Curve value the ledgers could not cover, clamped off the sell leg (0 on
a normal deleverage). See `SellEvent::book_shortfall`.

fields.name: y_shift
docs: See `SellEvent::y_shift` / `heal_spread` (prefix-compatible appends).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump, stored so every instruction re-derives instead of trusting input.

fields.name: version
docs: `2`. Mirrors the backend's `market.program_version` discriminator.

fields.name: curve_kind
docs: `0 = linear`, `1 = hinged exponential` (reserved) — matches the `CurveKind`
enum. A real discriminant: nothing may assume "a curve *is* a table"; the
closed-form tail family plugs in here.

fields.name: token_decimals
docs: `== mint_main.decimals == mint_token.decimals` (v1 invariant; the backend's
price maths depends on it).

fields.name: flags
docs: Permission bits — see the `flags` module above.
bit 0: CanBuy, bit 1: CanSell, bit 2: CanBorrow, bit 6: CanRaiseFloor,
bit 7: CanDeposit, bit 8: SelfHealing (creation-time only, never writable).

fields.name: creator
docs: Current creator-fee claimant. Reassignable via `update_market` (the CTO
path), so this is whoever *holds* the market, not necessarily who made it.

fields.name: mint_token
docs: The market's token mint — the market PDA seed (`["market", mint_token]`).

fields.name: mint_main
docs: Collateral (base currency) mint (e.g., USDC) — trades pay and pay out in it.

fields.name: token_program_main
docs: Resolved once from `mint_main.owner` and stored, so no later instruction has
to guess which token program the collateral belongs to.

fields.name: vault_bumps
docs: `[vault, collateral_vault, creator_claim]` — every instruction re-derives
from seeds + stored bump, which makes vault substitution structurally
impossible rather than checked.

fields.name: buy_fee_mbps
docs: Buy fee in mbps (`1_000_000` = 100%), copied from the pinned `FeeConfig`.

fields.name: sell_fee_mbps
docs: Sell fee, mbps — same snapshot.

fields.name: borrow_fee_mbps
docs: Origination fee on the borrowed amount, mbps — same snapshot.

fields.name: redeem_fee_mbps
docs: Reserved — mirrors `FeeConfig::redeem_fee_mbps` (`redeem_at_floor` was removed).

fields.name: fees_team
docs: Fee split in bps of the fee taken. One pinned, one supplied, one computed —
see `fees_floor`.

fields.name: fees_floor
docs: `10_000 − fees_team − fees_creator`, **computed, never supplied**. Deriving
it makes `Σ = 10_000` true by construction instead of by an assertion every
writer has to remember.

fields.name: q_max_bps
docs: Declared stress depth in bps of supply: the market promises this fraction is
sellable in one transaction, which caps how high `floor_price` may ratchet.

fields.name: char_params
docs: Curve parameters, meaning fixed by `curve_kind`:
* `HingedExponential` — `(p0, m, g2, k)` with `g2 = 2q/k²`, all Q64.64:
`M(x) = p0 + m·x + g2·(e^{k·d} − 1 − k·d)`, `d = max(x − hinge_x, 0)`
(see `docs/hinged-exp-fixed-point.md`); the hinge lives in `hinge_x`.
A generic slot on purpose: adding a curve family adds a `Characteristic`
implementation, not a `Market` layout change. There is **no curve table** —
the shape is these numbers, evaluated directly.
Formats: `p0` and `g2` are Q64.64 values; the per-raw-unit `m` and `k`
are Q64.96 (`curve::SLOPE_FRAC_EXTRA`) so ultra-low launch prices on
expensive many-decimal collateral stay representable.

fields.name: floor_price
docs: Q64.64. THE ratchet: monotone non-decreasing, forever.

fields.name: ramp_start_x
docs: `x1`, in raw table x-units (integer — kills a division on the hot path).

fields.name: ramp_scalar
docs: `s`, Q64.64. Pinned per preset, never a runtime lever: it carries the chord
certificate, and §7.5b's ramp-band routing depends on its immutability.

fields.name: x2_cached
docs: Memos, **not authority** — both re-derive from `{floor_price, ramp_start_x}`
and must be refreshed on every write to either. That refresh is the one new
bug class this design introduces; fuzz it.

fields.name: y_shift
docs: Reserved, inactive: activates only if WP0's replay proves v1 re-anchors `b₂`
on ramp sells.

fields.name: token_supply
docs: Circulating supply in raw token units — the `x` every curve is evaluated at.

fields.name: floor_reserve
docs: Book value of the floor earmark *inside* the single vault.

fields.name: price_reserve
docs: Book value of the above-floor exit book, same vault.

fields.name: total_debt
docs: Outstanding borrows across all positions, raw collateral units. Counted
as an obligation by every solvency check.

fields.name: total_collateral
docs: Market tokens locked in the collateral vault across all positions, raw units.

fields.name: total_fees_floor
docs: Cumulative fees routed to the floor reserve (raw collateral units).

fields.name: total_fees_creator
docs: Cumulative fees accrued to `creator_claim` (raw collateral units).

fields.name: total_fees_team
docs: Cumulative fees sent to the per-collateral team vault (raw collateral units).

fields.name: cum_net_inflow
docs: Glide progress key. **Cumulative net inflow, never wall-clock** — a
time-keyed glide is gameable by waiting.

fields.name: g0_mbps
docs: Glide start value, mbps: the share of a buy's premium credited to the
floor reserve at zero inflow (see `glide_at` in `buy.rs`).

fields.name: g_min_mbps
docs: Glide end value, mbps — what `g` decays to at `glide_end_inflow`.
Launch ships `g_min == g0` (flat), which short-circuits the decay entirely.

fields.name: glide_end_inflow
docs: Inflow at which `g` reaches `g_min` (linear decay between). Launch ships a
**flat** glide (`g_min == g0`), so this is inert until calibration.

fields.name: peak_price
docs: Highest effective spot seen since the last disarm. This is the memory that
makes the ratchet reflexive: it is what lets a raise know the market *was*
high even though it is no longer trading there.

fields.name: peak_slot
docs: Slot at which `peak_price` was latched. The reflexive window requires
`peak_slot < current_slot`, which is what makes a spike and the raise that
exploits it non-atomic.

fields.name: reflexive_arm_ratio_mbps
docs: Arm threshold as a multiple of the floor, in mbps (`1_800_000` = 1.8×). The
market is armed when `peak_price ≥ ratio × F`.

fields.name: reflexive_band_mbps
docs: Fire threshold as a multiple of the floor, in mbps (`1_300_000` = 1.3×). The
window is open when armed **and** `spot ≤ band × F` — i.e. the excursion has
retraced back toward the floor.

fields.name: reflexive_step_bps
docs: Per-operation cap while the reflexive window is open, replacing
`max_floor_step_bps`. A second cap rather than a multiplier: there is no
product to reason about, it is bounded by the same maximum, and setting it
equal to `max_floor_step_bps` disables the mechanism without a flag.

fields.name: starting_price
docs: Floor at creation. Display/analytics only — v1's cooldown ratio table is gone.

fields.name: last_floor_raise_ts
docs: Unix time of the last floor raise. Analytics only — no cooldown reads it;
`max_floor_step_bps` (below) is the sole throttle on raise velocity.

fields.name: floor_raise_count
docs: How many times the floor has been raised — the market's "level".
Analytics only, never read by a check.

fields.name: last_raise_slot
docs: One geometry write per slot (reentrancy bound, not a cooldown).

fields.name: max_floor_step_bps
docs: Per-operation ceiling on a floor raise, in bps of the current floor. With
cooldowns removed entirely this is the **only** throttle on raise velocity,
so it has to actually bind — v1's bound read as a 101× multiplier per call
with no time gate behind it.

fields.name: min_ramp_headroom_x
docs: Minimum gap the derived ramp end must keep below supply, in raw x-units.
Absolute units, not a fraction: the predicate is `x2 + headroom < supply`,
and a fraction would force a multiply and a rounding decision inside it.

fields.name: area_under_curve
docs: Event-only statistic, maintained incrementally for snapshots.

fields.name: state_seq
docs: Monotone, incremented wherever `assert_laws` runs and emitted in every
snapshot. The indexer is last-write-wins across three async writers with no
ordering key, so this is what lets it reject a stale update — and a gap in
it is the only mechanical detector for an event that never arrived.

fields.name: hinge_x
docs: Supply (raw units) where the hinged exponential ignites. Zero for the
linear family. Carved out of the former `reserved[96]` prefix, so the
account layout of live markets is unchanged (old bytes read as zero).

fields.name: reflection_bps
docs: Reflection tax pinned at creation, bps of the trade: 0 / 100 / 300.
Immutable for life. Carved out of the `reserved` prefix (88 → 86), so the
account layout of live markets is unchanged (old bytes read as zero =
no reflection). See `REFLECTION_TOKENS_DESIGN.md`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Padding. Grew by 32 bytes when the withdrawn-fee counters and the
area-shrink-budget window were removed as dead state — the fee-custody
decision made the withdrawn counters a permanent zero, and the preserve-area
raise enforces one-sided non-shrink directly rather than a budgeted δ. Keeping
the account size fixed lets those bytes back a future field without a
migration.

fields.name: name
docs: Full strings, not a hash: the indexer populates name/symbol/uri straight
from the event, so nothing has to be fetched back over RPC.

fields.name: buy_fee_mbps
docs: Trade-fee rates snapshotted from the FeeConfig — in the event so the
indexer never needs the FeeConfig account (or a DB copy of it) to fill a
market row. New fields sit after `state_seq`: historical events stay
prefix-compatible.

fields.name: hinge_x
docs: Hinge of the hinged-exponential family (0 for linear). Appended last,
per the prefix-compatibility rule above.

fields.name: reflection_bps
docs: Reflection tax pinned at creation (bps of the trade): 0 / 100 / 300.
Appended last, per the prefix-compatibility rule above.

fields.name: uri
docs: The creator's metadata JSON link (IPFS or otherwise). Stored inline in the
mint via the Token-2022 metadata extension — there is no Metaplex account.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump, stored so every instruction re-derives instead of trusting input.

fields.name: market
docs: The market this position belongs to. Seeds are
`["position", market, owner]`, so exactly one position exists per pair.

fields.name: owner
docs: The position holder — the other PDA seed.

fields.name: collateral
docs: Market tokens locked in the collateral vault, raw units.

fields.name: debt
docs: Outstanding principal in raw collateral units. Interest-free by design.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Padding so a future field needs no migration.

fields.name: redeem_fee_mbps
docs: `redeem_at_floor` was removed; kept so a future re-add needs no migration.

types.name: ReflectionAccruedEvent
docs: Emitted on every buy/sell (and their leverage variants) that carries a
non-zero reflection tax: the amount routed to the market's `reflection_vault`
and the running vault total after the leg.

fields.name: is_buy
docs: `true` = buy-side (buyer → vault), `false` = sell-side (vault → vault).

types.name: ReflectionDistributedEvent
docs: Emitted per `distribute_reflection` batch: how many holders were paid, the
running total distributed against the frozen pool, and the per-holder credits
(wallet + amount) so the indexer can record reward history without decoding
the instruction or resolving ATAs.

fields.name: pool
docs: Distributable pool frozen at open (already net of `gas_reserve`).

fields.name: paid_bitmap
docs: `ceil(holder_count / 8)` bytes; bit `i` = holder index `i` has been paid.

types.name: ReflectionEpochOpenedEvent
docs: Emitted when an admin opens a reflection distribution epoch: the pool is
frozen (net of the gas skim) and the per-holder bitmap is sized.

fields.name: pool
docs: Distributable pool frozen at open (already net of `gas_reserve`).

types.name: ReflectionPayment
docs: One holder's credit in a distribute batch. `owner` is ALWAYS the holder's
wallet — never the ATA: native markets pay the wallet directly; for SPL
markets the program reads the ATA's owner so the indexer records the wallet.

types.name: ReflectionPayout
docs: One holder's payout in a `distribute_reflection` batch. `index` keys the
epoch bitmap (the snapshot's stable ordering); the destination ATA is the
matching entry in `remaining_accounts`.

fields.name: floor_reserve
docs: Market-wide post-state, for the indexer's aggregate columns.

fields.name: contracted
docs: True when the sale landed inside the flat band and pulled `x1` down to the
new supply — which always leaves the market ramp-band.

fields.name: cum_net_inflow
docs: Post-trade glide progress + the post-contraction geometry memos. Carried on
every sell (unchanged values when `contracted` is false) so the indexer
mirrors curve state without re-deriving fixed-point maths off-chain.

fields.name: book_shortfall
docs: Curve value the ledgers could not cover, clamped off the payout (0 on a
normal sale). Non-zero means the unconditional-exit fallback engaged and
part of the sale effectively exited at the floor.

fields.name: y_shift
docs: Post-trade curve translation (SELF_HEALING.md); 0 on legacy markets.
Appended prefix-compatible: old decoders simply stop before it.

fields.name: heal_spread
docs: What the shoulder confiscated into the floor reserve this sale.

fields.name: creator
docs: New creator. `fees_floor` is recomputed from `fees_creator`; this
instruction never writes it directly and never touches `fees_team`, so the
leg sum cannot be broken here.

fields.name: reflexive
docs: Arm, retune, or disable the reflexive ratchet. `Some` with
`arm_ratio_mbps == 0` disables it; there is no separate flag, so the state
"armed but with nonsense thresholds" is unrepresentable.

fields.name: max_floor_step_bps

throttle on raise velocity, and the right value is a function of how the
market actually trades.
